scenarios.name: San Diego to Subic Bay, San Bernardino Strait denied, Subic Bay inside a WEZ
scenarios.purpose: S02's move, plus an illustrative WEZ: a 600 nm circle centred on the Taiwan Strait that takes in Luzon as far south as Manila and Batangas. Commercial carriers cannot enter it, so each class changes hands at the nearest port outside it that can take that class, and the military carries it in. The area of denial over the San Bernardino Strait also covers Cebu, so the handover moves to Mindanao.

scenarios.name: Singapore to Manila, central South China Sea denied, Manila inside a WEZ
scenarios.purpose: S08's move, plus the 600 nm WEZ. Commercial carriers go around Borneo and hand over in the central or southern Philippines. Classes that can move as breakbulk hand over at Cebu South Port, which the World Port Index records as handling breakbulk. Container-only classes and major end items go on to Cagayan de Oro, 45 nm further from Manila, because the index says nothing about containers, Ro-Ro or heavy lift at Cebu South Port. For ammunition, no handover port is nearer Manila than Singapore itself.
